create_local_directory_iterator: create a LocalDirectory instance to iterate over files matching a glob pattern in a local directory
shuffle_local_directory_files: shuffle the file list in a LocalDirectory instance using a reproducible random seed
iterate_directory_paths: iterate over all Path objects returned by a LocalDirectory instance using a for loop
review_local_directory_class: review the LocalDirectory class and its glob pattern traversal and shuffle capabilities
summarize_traverse_function: summarize the _traverse function that globs a directory and returns a sorted list of paths
